metadata.description: The Microsoft Sentinel workspace into which the function will be deployed. Has to be in the selected Resource Group.
The region of the selected workspace. The default value will use the Region selection above.

properties.displayName: Audit Event ASIM filtering parser for AWS CloudTrail EC2 CapacityAndReservations activity
properties.query:
let parser = (
  starttime:datetime=datetime(null),
  endtime:datetime=datetime(null),
  srcipaddr_has_any_prefix:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  actorusername_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  operation_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  eventtype_in:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  eventresult:string='*',
  object_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  newvalue_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  disabled:bool=false,
  pack:bool=false
) {
let Events = datatable(EventName: string, EventType: string, Object: string)
[
  "AcceptCapacityReservationBillingOwnership", "Execute", "Capacity Reservation",
  "AcceptReservedInstancesExchangeQuote", "Execute", "Convertible Reserved Instance",
  "AllocateHosts", "Create", "Dedicated Host",
  "AssociateCapacityReservationBillingOwner", "Set", "Capacity Reservation",
  "CancelCapacityReservation", "Delete", "Capacity Reservation",
  "CancelCapacityReservationFleets", "Delete", "Capacity Reservation",
  "CancelReservedInstancesListing", "Delete", "Reserved Instance Listing",
  "ConfirmProductInstance", "Execute", "EC2 Instance",
  "CreateCapacityManagerDataExport", "Create", "EC2 Capacity Manager Data Report",
  "CreateCapacityReservation", "Create", "Capacity Reservation",
  "CreateCapacityReservationBySplitting", "Create", "Capacity Reservation",
  "CreateCapacityReservationCancellationQuote", "Create", "Capacity Reservation Cancellation Quote",
  "CreateCapacityReservationDateChangeQuote", "Create", "Capacity Reservation Date Change Quote",
  "CreateCapacityReservationFleet", "Create", "Capacity Reservation Fleet",
  "CreateInterruptibleCapacityReservationAllocation", "Create", "Capacity Reservation",
  "CreateReservedInstancesListing", "Create", "Reserved Instance Listing",
  "DeleteCapacityManagerDataExport", "Delete", "Capacity Manager Configuration",
  "DeleteQueuedReservedInstances", "Delete", "Reserved Instance",
  "DescribeCapacityBlockExtensionHistory", "Read", "Capacity Block Extension History",
  "DescribeCapacityBlockExtensionOfferings", "Read", "Capacity Block Extension Offering",
  "DescribeCapacityBlockOfferings", "Read", "Capacity Block",
  "DescribeCapacityBlockStatus", "Read", "Capacity Block",
  "DescribeCapacityBlocks", "Read", "Capacity Block",
  "DescribeCapacityManagerDataExports", "Read", "Capacity Manager Data Exports",
  "DescribeCapacityReservationBillingRequests", "Read", "Capacity Reservation",
  "DescribeCapacityReservationCancellationQuotes", "Read", "Capacity Reservation Cancellation Quote",
  "DescribeCapacityReservationDateChangeQuotes", "Read", "Capacity Reservation Date Change Quote",
  "DescribeCapacityReservationFleets", "Read", "Capacity Reservation Fleet",
  "DescribeCapacityReservationTopology", "Read", "Capacity Reservation",
  "DescribeCapacityReservations", "Read", "Capacity Reservation",
  "DescribeHostReservationOfferings", "Read", "Dedicated Host Reservation",
  "DescribeHostReservations", "Read", "Dedicated Host Reservation",
  "DescribeHosts", "Read", "Dedicated Host",
  "DescribeMacHosts", "Read", "Dedicated Host",
  "DescribeReservedInstances", "Read", "Reserved Instance",
  "DescribeReservedInstancesListings", "Read", "Reserved Instance Listing",
  "DescribeReservedInstancesModifications", "Read", "Reserved Instance Modification",
  "DescribeReservedInstancesOfferings", "Read", "Reserved Instance Offering",
  "DescribeScheduledInstanceAvailability", "Read", "EC2 Instance",
  "DescribeScheduledInstances", "Read", "EC2 Instance",
  "DisableCapacityManager", "Disable", "Capacity Manager",
  "DisassociateCapacityReservationBillingOwner", "Delete", "Capacity Reservation",
  "EnableCapacityManager", "Enable", "Capacity Manager",
  "GetCapacityManagerAttributes", "Read", "Capacity Manager",
  "GetCapacityManagerMetricData", "Read", "Capacity Manager",
  "GetCapacityManagerMetricDimensions", "Read", "Capacity Manager",
  "GetCapacityManagerMonitoredTagKeys", "Read", "Capacity Manager Monitored Tag Keys",
  "GetCapacityReservationUsage", "Read", "Capacity Reservation",
  "GetGroupsForCapacityReservation", "Read", "Capacity Reservation",
  "GetHostReservationPurchasePreview", "Read", "Dedicated Host",
  "GetReservedInstancesExchangeQuote", "Read", "Reserved Instance",
  "ModifyCapacityReservation", "Set", "Capacity Reservation",
  "ModifyCapacityReservationFleet", "Set", "Capacity Reservation Fleet",
  "ModifyHosts", "Set", "Dedicated Host",
  "ModifyReservedInstances", "Set", "Reserved Instance",
  "MoveCapacityReservationInstances", "Execute", "Capacity Reservation",
  "PurchaseCapacityBlock", "Create", "Capacity Block",
  "PurchaseCapacityBlockExtension", "Create", "Capacity Block",
  "PurchaseHostReservation", "Create", "Dedicated Host",
  "PurchaseReservedInstancesOffering", "Create", "Reserved Instance",
  "PurchaseScheduledInstances", "Create", "Scheduled Instance",
  "RejectCapacityReservationBillingOwnership", "Execute", "Capacity Reservation",
  "ReleaseHosts", "Delete", "Dedicated Host",
  "RunScheduledInstances", "Create", "EC2 Instance",
  "UpdateCapacityManagerMonitoredTagKeys", "Set", "Capacity Manager Monitored Tag Keys",
  "UpdateCapacityManagerOrganizationsAccess", "Set", "Capacity Manager",
  "UpdateInterruptibleCapacityReservationAllocation", "Set", "Capacity Reservation"
]
| where array_length(eventtype_in) == 0 or EventType in (eventtype_in)
| where array_length(object_has_any) == 0 or Object has_any (object_has_any);
AWSCloudTrail
| where not(disabled)
| where EventSource == "ec2.amazonaws.com"
| where (isnull(starttime) or TimeGenerated >= starttime)
    and (isnull(endtime) or TimeGenerated <= endtime)
| where array_length(operation_has_any) == 0 or EventName has_any (operation_has_any)
| where array_length(actorusername_has_any) == 0 or UserIdentityUserName has_any (actorusername_has_any)
| where array_length(srcipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0
    or (ipv4_is_in_range(SourceIpAddress, "0.0.0.0/0")
        and has_any_ipv4_prefix(SourceIpAddress, srcipaddr_has_any_prefix))
| where EventName in (Events | project EventName)
| extend EventResult = iff(isempty(ErrorCode) and isempty(ErrorMessage), "Success", "Failure")
| where eventresult == "*" or EventResult == eventresult
| lookup kind=inner Events on EventName
| extend Req = todynamic(RequestParameters), Resp = todynamic(ResponseElements)
| extend NewValue = iff(EventResult == "Success", case(
    EventName == "AllocateHosts", Resp.hostIdSet,
    EventName == "AssociateCapacityReservationBillingOwner", Req.CapacityReservationId,
    EventName == "CancelCapacityReservationFleets", Resp.successfulFleetCancellationSet,
    EventName in ("CancelReservedInstancesListing", "CreateReservedInstancesListing"),
      Resp.reservedInstancesListingsSet,
    EventName == "ConfirmProductInstance", Resp.ownerId,
    EventName == "CreateCapacityManagerDataExport", Resp.capacityManagerDataExportId,
    EventName == "CreateCapacityReservation", Resp.capacityReservation,
    EventName in ("CreateCapacityReservationBySplitting", "MoveCapacityReservationInstances"),
      Resp.destinationCapacityReservation,
    EventName == "CreateCapacityReservationCancellationQuote",
      Resp.capacityReservationCancellationQuote,
    EventName == "CreateCapacityReservationDateChangeQuote",
      Resp.capacityReservationModificationQuote,
    EventName == "CreateCapacityReservationFleet", Resp.state,
    EventName == "CreateInterruptibleCapacityReservationAllocation", Resp.interruptionType,
    EventName == "EnableCapacityManager", Resp.output,
    EventName == "ModifyReservedInstances", Req.ReservedInstancesConfigurationSetItemType.N,
    EventName == "PurchaseCapacityBlock", Resp.capacityBlockSet,
    EventName == "PurchaseCapacityBlockExtension", Resp.capacityBlockExtensionSet,
    EventName == "PurchaseReservedInstancesOffering", Resp.reservedInstancesId,
    EventName == "PurchaseScheduledInstances", Resp.scheduledInstanceSet,
    EventName == "RunScheduledInstances", Resp.instanceIdSet,
    EventName == "UpdateCapacityManagerMonitoredTagKeys", Resp.capacityManagerTagKeySet,
    EventName == "UpdateInterruptibleCapacityReservationAllocation", Req.TargetInstanceCount,
    ""
  ), "")
| where array_length(newvalue_has_any) == 0 or NewValue has_any (newvalue_has_any)
| extend ObjectId = case(
    EventName in ("AcceptCapacityReservationBillingOwnership", "AssociateCapacityReservationBillingOwner",
      "CancelCapacityReservation", "DescribeCapacityBlockExtensionHistory",
      "DescribeCapacityBlockExtensionOfferings", "DescribeCapacityReservationBillingRequests",
      "DescribeCapacityReservationTopology", "DescribeCapacityReservations",
      "DisassociateCapacityReservationBillingOwner", "GetGroupsForCapacityReservation",
      "ModifyCapacityReservation", "RejectCapacityReservationBillingOwnership"),
      Req.CapacityReservationId,
    EventName == "AcceptReservedInstancesExchangeQuote", Resp.exchangeId,
    EventName == "AllocateHosts", Resp.hostIdSet,
    EventName in ("CancelCapacityReservationFleets", "DescribeCapacityReservationFleets",
      "ModifyCapacityReservationFleet"), Req.CapacityReservationFleetId,
    EventName == "CancelReservedInstancesListing", Req.ReservedInstancesListingId,
    EventName == "ConfirmProductInstance", Req.InstanceId,
    EventName in ("CreateCapacityManagerDataExport", "DeleteCapacityManagerDataExport"),
      Resp.capacityManagerDataExportId,
    EventName == "CreateCapacityReservation", Resp.capacityReservation.capacityReservationId,
    EventName == "CreateCapacityReservationBySplitting",
      Resp.destinationCapacityReservation.destinationCapacitySplittingId,
    EventName == "CreateCapacityReservationCancellationQuote",
      Resp.capacityReservationCancellationQuote.capacityReservationCancellationQuoteId,
    EventName == "CreateCapacityReservationDateChangeQuote",
      Resp.capacityReservationModificationQuote.capacityReservationModificationQuoteId,
    EventName == "CreateCapacityReservationFleet", Resp.capacityReservationFleetId,
    EventName in ("CreateInterruptibleCapacityReservationAllocation",
      "UpdateInterruptibleCapacityReservationAllocation"), Resp.sourceCapacityReservationId,
    EventName in ("CreateReservedInstancesListing", "DeleteQueuedReservedInstances",
      "DescribeReservedInstances", "DescribeReservedInstancesListings", "ModifyReservedInstances"),
      Req.ReservedInstancesId,
    EventName in ("DescribeCapacityBlockStatus", "DescribeCapacityBlocks"), Req.CapacityBlockId,
    EventName == "DescribeCapacityManagerDataExports", Req.CapacityManagerDataExportId,
    EventName in ("DescribeHostReservationOfferings", "GetHostReservationPurchasePreview"),
      Req.OfferingId,
    EventName == "DescribeHostReservations", Req.HostReservationIdSet,
    EventName in ("DescribeHosts", "DescribeMacHosts", "ModifyHosts", "ReleaseHosts"),
      Req.HostId,
    EventName == "DescribeReservedInstancesModifications", Req.ReservedInstancesModificationId,
    EventName in ("DescribeReservedInstancesOfferings", "PurchaseReservedInstancesOffering"),
      Req.ReservedInstancesOfferingId,
    EventName in ("DescribeScheduledInstances", "RunScheduledInstances"),
      Req.ScheduledInstanceId,
    EventName == "GetCapacityReservationUsage", Resp.capacityReservationId,
    EventName == "GetReservedInstancesExchangeQuote", Req.ReservedInstanceId,
    EventName == "MoveCapacityReservationInstances", Req.SourceCapacityReservationId,
    EventName in ("PurchaseCapacityBlock", "PurchaseCapacityBlockExtension"),
      Req.CapacityBlockOfferingId,
    EventName == "PurchaseHostReservation", Req.HostIdSet,
    EventName == "PurchaseScheduledInstances", Req.PurchaseRequest,
    ""
  )
| extend
    Type = "AWSCloudTrail",
    EventCount = int(1),
    EventStartTime = TimeGenerated,
    EventEndTime = TimeGenerated,
    EventSeverity = "Informational",
    EventSchema = "AuditEvent",
    EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
    EventVendor = "AWS",
    EventProduct = "CloudTrail",
    Dvc = "CloudTrail",
    EventMessage = ErrorMessage,
    ObjectType = "Cloud Resource",
    TargetAppName = "Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud",
    TargetAppType = "Service"
| project-rename
    EventOriginalSubType = EventTypeName,
    EventOriginalType = EventName,
    EventUid = AwsEventId,
    EventOriginalResultDetails = ErrorMessage,
    EventProductVersion = EventVersion,
    ActorUserId = UserIdentityAccountId,
    ActorUsername = UserIdentityUserName,
    ActorOriginalUserType = UserIdentityType,
    HttpUserAgent = UserAgent
| extend
    ActorUserIdType = iff(isempty(ActorUserId), "", "AWSId"),
    ActorUsernameType = iff(isempty(ActorUsername), "", "Simple"),
    SrcIpAddr = iff(ipv4_is_in_range(SourceIpAddress, "0.0.0.0/0"), SourceIpAddress, ""),
    ActingApplicationEntityKey = "",
    ActorUserAdditionalIds = dynamic([]),
    ActorUserEntityKey = "",
    AdditionalEntities = dynamic([]),
    DvcEntityKey = "",
    SrcSystemEntityKey = "",
    TargetApplicationEntityKey = "",
    TargetSystemEntityKey = ""
| extend AdditionalFields = iff(pack, bag_pack(
    "ActorAccessKeyId", UserIdentityAccessKeyId,
    "AWSRegion", AWSRegion,
    "APIVersion", APIVersion,
    "ManagementEvent", ManagementEvent,
    "ReadOnly", ReadOnly,
    "RequestParameters", Req,
    "ResponseElements", Resp
  ), dynamic({}))
| extend
    Operation = EventOriginalType,
    User = ActorUsername,
    IpAddr = SrcIpAddr,
    Application = TargetAppName,
    Value = NewValue
| project
    TimeGenerated, Type, EventCount, EventStartTime, EventEndTime, EventSeverity,
    EventSchema, EventSchemaVersion, EventVendor, EventProduct, Dvc, EventResult,
    EventMessage, TargetAppName, EventOriginalSubType, EventOriginalType, EventUid,
    EventOriginalResultDetails, EventProductVersion, ActorUserId, ActorUsername,
    ActorOriginalUserType, HttpUserAgent, ActorUserIdType, ActorUsernameType,
    SrcIpAddr, AdditionalFields, User, IpAddr, Application, EventType, NewValue,
    Value, ObjectId, ObjectType, Object, TargetAppType, Operation,
    ActingApplicationEntityKey, ActorUserAdditionalIds, ActorUserEntityKey,
    AdditionalEntities, DvcEntityKey, SrcSystemEntityKey,
    TargetApplicationEntityKey, TargetSystemEntityKey
};
parser(
  starttime,
  endtime,
  srcipaddr_has_any_prefix,
  actorusername_has_any,
  operation_has_any,
  eventtype_in,
  eventresult,
  object_has_any,
  newvalue_has_any,
  disabled,
  pack
)
